note: Runtime and architecture choices. Exact dependency versions are recorded in frontend/bun.lock, backend/uv.lock and tools/api-client/bun.lock.

frontend.ui: shadcn 4.21.0 vendored via `bun run ui:add`, Base UI base-vega

decisions: TanStack Start serves the SPA and Better Auth on one origin.
Better Auth/Drizzle owns auth; FastAPI/SQLAlchemy/Alembic owns app.
The API client generator is isolated with TypeScript 6; the frontend uses TypeScript 7.
Audio and meeting text must only be processed by local or self-hosted models.
